# Config changes reach the panes (run with a config folder of its own,
# @CFG@): a file written in place (VS Code, nano, >>) or replaced (most
# editors), a theme file the config names, the system's light/dark switch
# with `theme = light:A,dark:B`, and Reload Configuration — which also takes
# every pane back to `font-size` after ⌘+.
#
# Starts with: font-size = 14, theme = probe-theme (background #112233).
expect-font:14
expect-background:#112233
# Written in place.
shell:printf 'font-size = 16\ntheme = probe-theme\n' > @CFG@/config
wait:0.6
expect-font:16
# Replaced, as most editors save.
shell:printf 'font-size = 15\ntheme = probe-theme\n' > @CFG@/config.new && mv @CFG@/config.new @CFG@/config
wait:0.6
expect-font:15
# The theme's own file, in place and replaced: the panes take its colors.
shell:printf 'background = #445566\n' > @CFG@/themes/probe-theme
wait:0.6
expect-background:#445566
shell:printf 'background = #778899\n' > @CFG@/themes/probe-theme.new && mv @CFG@/themes/probe-theme.new @CFG@/themes/probe-theme
wait:0.6
expect-background:#778899
# ⌘+ stays through edits that don't touch font-size…
action:increase_font_size:1
expect-font:16
shell:printf 'font-size = 15\ntheme = probe-theme\nscrollback-limit = 5000\n' > @CFG@/config
wait:0.6
expect-font:16
# …and Reload Configuration takes the pane back to it.
reload:config
expect-font:15
# Light and dark themes follow the system's appearance.
shell:printf 'font-size = 15\ntheme = light:Libertty Light,dark:Libertty Dark\n' > @CFG@/config
wait:0.6
appearance:light
expect-background:#faf9f6
appearance:dark
expect-background:#1c1c1e
# A theme named by its path, saved by deleting it and writing it anew (the
# config refuses it while it's gone, and takes it once it's back).
shell:echo 'background = #135790' > @CFG@/own-theme && printf 'theme = @CFG@/own-theme\n' > @CFG@/config
wait:0.6
expect-background:#135790
shell:rm @CFG@/own-theme
wait:0.4
shell:echo 'background = #abcdef' > @CFG@/own-theme
wait:0.6
expect-background:#abcdef
